title: Why you can focus on one voice in a noisy room
hook: Why can you hear your name in a crowded, noisy room?

narration.text: Your brain performs an amazing trick in noisy places.
It can filter out distracting sounds and focus on a single conversation.
This is called the cocktail party effect.
Your brain constantly processes all incoming sounds.
It prioritises information it deems important or relevant.
Like your name, or a topic you are very interested in.
It lets you follow one voice amidst many.
Next time you are in a noisy place, notice what your brain chooses to hear.
Have you ever experienced this sudden shift in focus?

description: Discover how your brain filters out noise to focus on a single conversation, even in the busiest environments. Learn about the fascinating phenomenon known as the cocktail party effect and how it impacts your daily hearing.
topic: Why you can focus on one conversation in a noisy room, explaining the cocktail party effect.
